updates.note: Facility still operating as an off-road park (Sunday hours per county tourism directory; youth directory verified 2026-01 lists a dirt-bike pee-wee track). A 2024 rider video describes a hare-scramble loop and pee-wee track rather than a groomed MX track. Status set open with low confidence; dirt-bike access still conflicts with an early-2025 report.

soil.notes: Former lime-rock quarry: rock gardens and limerock hard sections mixed with sandy stretches and some red clay trails, with mud pits after rain. Sources still disagree on the dominant surface.

layout.notes: Quarry terrain gives real climbs and drops unusual for Florida. Current dirt-bike riding is a hare-scramble loop plus a natural-terrain pee-wee track; the old groomed MX tracks are not confirmed to still be run.

conditions.seasonal: County tourism listing shows Sunday-only hours (10am-5pm). Call ahead: access by vehicle type has changed over time.

rider_reports.says: A rider video shows the park welcoming dirt bikes, side-by-sides and Jeeps, with a roughly 3.3-mile hare-scramble loop, a pee-wee track and a large 4x4-only hill-climb area; the creator rates it worth the trip.

An off-road blog says that around early 2025 the park was running weekends for 4x4s and side-by-sides only, with bikes and quads not allowed, and that for-sale signs were seen in late 2024; the article contradicts itself elsewhere, so treat as unconfirmed.

updates.note: Operator site now confirms address (17000 NE US Hwy 301), phone and a clay main track; dated 2026 events (MX des States Feb 2026, Swampfest Mar 2026, first summer camp Jun 2026) confirm open under RAD Sports ownership. Soil raised to medium (operator says natural clay; vintage series and RiderPlanet describe softer clay/dirt with little sand).
tracks_on_site: BMX track and skate bowl (Swampfest only)

soil.notes: Operator describes the main track as built on natural Florida clay; a vintage series page says the dirt runs on the softer side; RiderPlanet rates it mostly loose dirt with little sand. Reads as a soft clay/dirt mix rather than deep sand.

layout.notes: Main track about 1-1.5 miles, recently renovated, with technical rhythm sections, big jumps and a flow aimed at intermediate-to-expert riders on 125cc and up. Start straight is very wide (about 100 ft) and pinches to about 20 ft at turn one. Separate pit-bike track with scaled jumps and a slower technical woods loop.

conditions.seasonal: Practice most weekends year-round per operator; winter base for traveling riders. 2026 events included MX des States / SSVMX vintage round (Feb), Swampfest BMX festival (Mar), summer camps (Jun). RAD Sports bought the property Oct 2025.
conditions.watering_prep: Directory says watered and groomed; operator says main track recently renovated.

rider_reports.says: A local news piece on the first summer camp notes race starts of 10-40 riders on a gate area about 100 feet wide that narrows to about 20 feet into the first turn; families describe a welcoming community.
A vintage MX series describes Waldo's 1+ mile track as suited to all levels with a mix of jumps and flowing corners, and notes the dirt is on the softer side.
